key_insight: Astronomix is a high-order, differentiable (magneto)hydrodynamics simulator in JAX that enables accurate physics simulation, inverse modeling, and ML training directly inside the solver.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical path to scalable, GPU-accelerated fluid and MHD workflows with automatic differentiation for sensitivity analysis, parameter inference, and stability studies.
method: Automatic differentiation validated against analytical derivatives and finite differences
evidence_signal: The abstract reports single-GPU performance on par with AthenaPK at the same resolution, lower error on smooth problems, 6.5× strong scaling on 8 GPUs, and 76% weak scaling efficiency on 16 GPUs across 4 nodes.
watch_item: High-order differentiable kernels and multi-GPU performance depend on careful implementation and validation, especially for custom Pallas GPU code and stability in coupled gravity-MHD problems.
paper_title: Per Astronomix ad Astra: High-Order Differentiable (Magneto)hydrodynamics with Energy-Conserving Self-Gravity
